name: Your Company
tagline: Metal sculpture and art objects for parks, restaurants and offices

listing.description: A website for a metal-art studio: the name spread across the whole screen, a dated project index and works hung in frames as in a gallery.

seo.title: Your Company — metal art objects and sculpture in Tashkent
seo.description: We design and build sculptures, monoliths, photo spots and wayfinding in Corten and stainless steel for parks, malls, restaurants and offices. Concept in 5 days, installation included.
seo.answer: Your Company is a Tashkent studio making sculptures, monoliths, photo spots and wayfinding in metal (Corten, stainless steel, brass) for parks and businesses. A small art object starts at 18,000,000 UZS, a photo spot at 32,000,000 UZS; concepts take 5 working days and fabrication 4–8 weeks. Phone +998 71 200-07-04.

sections.title: Metal in the city: art objects for public spaces
sections.subtitle: Sculptures, monoliths and photo spots in Corten, stainless steel and brass. We shape the piece for its site, engineer the structure and install something built to last decades.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: We make metal that people stop to look at
sections.text: The studio is a sculptor, a structural engineer and six craftsmen. We start with the site: where the piece will stand, where it will be seen from, how the evening light will fall on it. Then we build a scale model, calculate wind loads and only then cut steel.

items.title: “Rust garden”
items.text: Five leaf sculptures up to 3.2 m tall along a promenade.

items.title: Business-centre monolith
items.text: A six-metre illuminated monolith with replaceable tenant panels.

items.title: “Heart of the city” photo spot
items.text: A heart of 480 plates that draws a queue of people waiting for photos.

items.title: Restaurant wall panel
items.text: A twelve-metre wall with a laser-cut suzani ornament.

items.title: Small art object
items.text: Up to 2 m, for an entrance or interior.

items.title: Monolith and wayfinding
items.text: Signs, monoliths and address plates in one style.

items.title: Park sculpture
items.text: Large-scale work with foundations and load calculations.

items.quote: The photo spot paid for itself in attention — people tag it in stories every day.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: They built a monolith we are proud to have at the entrance, and finished before the opening.
items.author: Timur

items.q: How long does a piece take?
items.a: Concept and model take 5 working days; fabrication 4 to 8 weeks depending on size.

items.q: Will Corten stain the paving with rust?
items.a: We pre-patinate the steel and set the piece on a drained base so run-off does not reach the paving.

items.q: Can you work from our sketch?
items.a: Yes, we develop your sketch into working drawings and engineer the structure.
Yes, across Uzbekistan; delivery and installation are priced separately.
